paragraphs.chinese:
这一集发生在圣诞节前。每个家庭对节日应该怎么过都有自己的想法，结果三家的计划都开始出问题。

在邓菲家，克莱尔发现沙发上有一块看起来像烟头烫出来的痕迹。三个孩子谁也不承认自己抽过烟，于是菲尔郑重宣布：如果没人说出真相，圣诞节就取消。

克莱尔觉得他做得太过火了，但菲尔拒绝退让。他们把圣诞树和所有装饰都撤了下来，希望孩子中有人会主动承认。海莉、亚历克斯和卢克不停互相指责，可还是没有人认错。

最后，亚历克斯说是自己干的。菲尔和克莱尔把圣诞节恢复了，不过仍然因为抽烟和撒谎而惩罚她。后来，阳光穿过一个玻璃装饰品，竟然在沙发同一个位置烫出了新的痕迹。父母这才发现，原来的焦痕根本不是任何一个孩子造成的。亚历克斯之所以承认，只是不想让全家人一起失去圣诞节。

与此同时，杰想按照克莱尔和米切尔小时候的方式过圣诞节。他安排了完整的流程，包括穿睡衣、拍全家福，以及一大早拆礼物。

格洛丽亚和曼尼却有完全不同的传统。在哥伦比亚，他们会在午夜拆礼物、吃哥伦比亚食物，还会互相搞恶作剧。杰觉得那些玩笑很烦，一直试图让他们照自己的安排来。

和卡梅隆谈过后，杰意识到，他不能简单地把自己和旧家庭曾经度过的圣诞节重新复制一遍。他需要和格洛丽亚、曼尼一起创造新的回忆。曼尼也明白了杰为什么如此看重过去的传统。最后，他们把两种圣诞节的过法结合到了一起。

米切尔和卡梅隆带莉莉去商场，拍她人生中第一张和圣诞老人的合照。米切尔抱怨那个圣诞老人太瘦，结果害得对方丢了工作。两个人感到内疚，于是邀请他来家里吃晚饭。

这位前圣诞老人名叫斯科特，是个很孤独的人，经常搬来搬去，做着各种不同的工作。他在家里时，卡梅隆看到了那个曾经把自己赶走的颂歌合唱团。他想报复，但斯科特谈起了宽恕，于是卡梅隆决定做个更成熟的人。结果那些歌手还是羞辱了他，斯科特便认定卡梅隆是“好孩子”，而他们才是“坏孩子”。

到了最后，家长们都犯了错，一些传统也发生了变化，但每个家庭仍然找到了属于自己的方式，一起享受圣诞节。
paragraphs.english:
This episode takes place just before Christmas. Each family has its own idea of what the holiday should look like, and all three plans start going wrong.

At the Dunphy house, Claire finds what looks like a cigarette burn on the couch. None of the children admits to smoking, so Phil makes a big announcement: if no one tells the truth, Christmas is canceled.

Claire thinks he’s gone too far, but Phil refuses to back down. They remove the tree and all the decorations, hoping one of the kids will confess. Haley, Alex, and Luke keep blaming one another, but no one admits anything.

Eventually, Alex says she did it. Phil and Claire bring Christmas back, although they still punish her for smoking and lying. Later, sunlight shines through a glass ornament and starts burning the couch in the exact same place. The parents realize that none of the children caused the original mark. Alex only confessed because she didn’t want the whole family to lose Christmas.

Meanwhile, Jay wants to celebrate Christmas the way he did when Claire and Mitchell were young. He has a full schedule planned, including pajamas, family pictures, and opening presents early in the morning.

Gloria and Manny have very different traditions. In Colombia, they open presents at midnight, eat Colombian food, and play practical jokes on one another. Jay finds the jokes annoying and keeps trying to make them follow his plan.

After talking to Cameron, Jay realizes that he can’t simply recreate the Christmases he had with his old family. He needs to make new memories with Gloria and Manny. Manny also understands why Jay cares so much about his old traditions. In the end, they mix both kinds of Christmas together.

Mitchell and Cameron take Lily to the mall for her first picture with Santa. Mitchell complains that the Santa is too thin, and the man gets fired. Feeling guilty, they invite him home for dinner.

The former Santa, Scott, turns out to be a lonely man who moves from place to place doing different jobs. While he’s there, Cameron sees the caroling group that once kicked him out. He wants revenge, but Scott talks about forgiveness, so Cameron tries to be the bigger person. The singers insult him anyway, and Scott decides that Cameron was nice but they were naughty.

By the end, the parents have made mistakes and some traditions have changed, but each family still finds its own way to enjoy Christmas together.
